verdict.rationale: Cekura ships automations, such as scheduled cron jobs and GitHub Actions test workflows, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows Cekura versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those automations. A/B testing compares versions of the user's voice agent rather than automation definitions. Any version control of GitHub Actions workflow files would come from the host platform or the user, not from Cekura.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
